svg.title: Figure 3-1: task-by-zone matrix
svg.desc: A grid with the eleven tasks down the side and the five zones across: one green cell, the bench task in the test area, which is all that is inside the case at the current baseline; amber cells where a task becomes permitted once a named safety function is validated on the 2.0 base, with the speed limit written in; grey cells excluded.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Figure 3-1 Task-by-zone matrix: where each task may run, now and once the safety functions exist

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Green: inside the case at BL-001 (after DQ-011 C, only bench work with the wheels off the ground). Amber: permitted once the named safety function is validated, on the 2.0 base. Grey: excluded.
